title: Integrative in silico and in vitro approach for clarifying mode of action to activate estrogen receptor alpha and lipid accumulation by methiocarb.
authors: Jeong, Da-Hyun; Pathak, Rajesh Kumar; Lee, Eunhee; Kim, Jun-Mo; Lee, Hee-Seok
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接预测农药甲硫威与雌激素受体α的结合，并通过报告基因和脂质积累实验验证其激活效应，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为核受体而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Disruption of estrogen receptor alpha (ERalpha) by endocrine-active pesticides may contribute to lipid metabolic dysregulation. We aimed to clarify the docking dynamics of methiocarb with ERalpha and evaluate its potential to induce lipid accumulation through ERalpha activation using non-animal testing systems. Molecular docking predicted favorable binding between methiocarb and ERalpha, primarily through interactions involving the amino group. This prediction was validated using ERalpha reporter gene assays. Methiocarb-induced lipid accumulation was assessed in 3T3-L1 adipocytes, with or without co-treatment using the ERalpha antagonist methyl-piperidino-pyrazole (MPP). Methiocarb significantly activated ERalpha transcriptional activity and promoted ERalpha-dependent lipid accumulation. Co-treatment with MPP attenuated this effect, whereas antagonists for the glucocorticoid receptor (RU-486) and ERbeta (PHTPP) had no effect. Methiocarb increased the expression of adipogenic and lipogenic transcription factors, including PPARgamma, C/EBPalpha, FAS, and SREBP1, as well as the adipocyte-specific marker FABP4, in an ERalpha-dependent manner. Methiocarb binding to ERalpha promotes lipid accumulation and upregulates adipogenic/lipogenic transcriptional networks. This approach highlights the utility of ERalpha-mediated screening to identify potential metabolic disruptors among structurally related pesticides.
abstract_zh: 内分泌活性农药对雌激素受体α（ERalpha）的干扰可能促进脂质代谢失调。我们旨在利用非动物测试系统，阐明灭虫威与ERalpha的对接动力学，并评估其通过ERalpha激活诱导脂质积累的潜力。分子对接预测灭虫威与ERalpha之间存在有利结合，主要通过涉及氨基的相互作用实现。该预测通过ERalpha报告基因实验得到验证。在3T3-L1脂肪细胞中评估了灭虫威诱导的脂质积累，并联合或不联合使用ERalpha拮抗剂甲基哌啶吡唑（MPP）处理。灭虫威显著激活ERalpha转录活性，并促进ERalpha依赖性脂质积累。联合MPP处理减弱了此效应，而糖皮质激素受体（RU-486）和ERbeta（PHTPP）的拮抗剂则无影响。灭虫威以ERalpha依赖性方式增加了脂肪生成和脂质生成转录因子的表达，包括PPARgamma、C/EBPalpha、FAS和SREBP1，以及脂肪细胞特异性标志物FABP4。灭虫威与ERalpha的结合促进脂质积累，并上调脂肪生成/脂质生成转录网络。该方法突显了ERalpha介导筛选在识别结构相关农药中潜在代谢干扰物方面的实用性。
